I've updated `index.css` to fix the empty dead space. Because `zoom: 0.75` scales the entire application down to 75% of its original size, the viewport effectively becomes smaller (leaving 25% empty space on the right and bottom). 

To counteract this while keeping the 75% scale, I applied the inverse scaling (`1 / 0.75 = 1.333...`) to the `body` element's `width` and `min-height`:
- `width: calc(100% / 0.75);` (which translates to 133.33%)
- `min-height: calc(100vh / 0.75);` (which translates to 133.33vh)
- `overflow-x: hidden;` to prevent horizontal scrolling issues.

This makes the body naturally fill the entire available screen area after the 75% zoom is applied, resolving the massive gap.
